name: Palomar 1 (Hubble)
blurb: Palomar 1, a faint, sparse globular cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: palomar1-hubble
story: Out in the Milky Way's halo, this sparse little globular cluster is a youngster among some of the oldest objects in a galaxy, and astronomers suspect it formed in a more sedate manner than its kin.

claims.text: Palomar 1 is an unusual, faint and sparse globular cluster
Globular clusters are found in the Milky Way's halo and are among the oldest objects in a galaxy
Palomar 1 is a youngster in globular cluster terms and may have formed in a more sedate manner
